title: Barchiyo me dil ka tukda reh gaya
body:
Barchiyo me dil ka tukda reh gaya
Sheh ki aankho'n me andhera reh gaya
Ae falak sehne sitam ke waaste
kya nabi zaado'n ka kunba reh gaya
<<DIVIDER>>
Noke naiza par sare akber se saath
Umme laila ka kaleja reh gaya
Ab na wo akber hai na husno shabaab
Haa'n magar dunya me charcha reh gaya
<<DIVIDER>>
Odh'ti kyu kar rida binte ali
Be kafan bhai ka lasha reh gaya
Isko kehte hai wafa ahle wafa
Bhar ke saqqa mashk pyaasa reh gaya
<<DIVIDER>>
Jal gaye qaime ridaaei'n chin gayi
qaanae zahra me ab kya reh gaya
Jhaad kar daaman shahedee'n uth gaye
Maalike kounain tanha reh gaya
